text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, it's time for our first concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Then let's go with what we did
last
rehearsal. No need for smoke in the
finale. Mhm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello is giving out some
last-minute
directions to the stage crew.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths... deep breaths...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just need to get my song out to
everyone. I
did everything I could to
prepare for today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Like, yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll be having a concert soon! Please
stop by
and listen!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Morning, Bourbon! You have to come to our concert, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have to? Is that an order, then?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep! A super special order from Falco!
See you
there!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Order received.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I put a lot of effort into spreading the
word, right
up until the last minute! This
time...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure that the songs
everyone
worked so hard to prepare...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Reach the hearts of as many people as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Smart Falcon's lips trembling
ever so
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
I can do it! I'll get everyone
hyped
up so they want to pitch in to our
project.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...
choice_data_list: You don't have to carry the excite...
You don't have to carry the excite...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When they go out on stage, they won't
be alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They'll have us waiting in the wings, and
the
audience in front of them.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: We should just get everyone involved!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You're right. We're here to ask everyone for help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll rope everyone in on the fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right, off I go!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... First, I will observe what
exactly you
all have cooked up with this
concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Suzuka? Suuuzuuukaaa?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm right here.
You don't have to shout.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And you don't have to be so cold all the
time. At any rate, do be sure to pay
close attention to
what's about to
unfold.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even the weakest of electrical signals can
stimulate the brain. The question is
whether or not that stimulation will lead
to the desired
reaction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And whether or not we'll find the piece
we need.
It all begins with observation.
